|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4, in date order). It is not the current version. The current version is [[Allegiant General Pryde (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).
* '''Original''' ([[Allegiant General Pryde]], 12 May 2020): Original: the first Players Committee card image in the Holotable image set (12 May 2020); the set was released 22 March 2020, and no earlier image of the card was found. Players Committee card image, 12 May 2020: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-allegiantgeneralpryde-20200512.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/large/allegiantgeneralpryde.gif Holotable commit a5142dd “Tweak set images”], no mark). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Hux is lost. While with a Resistance character, adds one battle destiny. While Emperor on table, attrition against opponent here is +1 for each First Order character here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Allegiant General Pryde (Errata)]], 18 March 2021): Players Committee card image, 18 March 2021: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-allegiantgeneralpryde-20210318.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2f0f28b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/allegiantgeneralpryde.png Holotable commit 2f0f28b “2021 March Errata”], mark “E”). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Hux is forfeit -3. While with a Resistance character, adds one battle destiny. While Emperor on table, attrition against opponent here is +1 for each First Order character here (limit +3).” '''What changed:''' “Hux is lost.” became “Hux is forfeit -3.”; “(limit +3)” added at the end.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 20 February 2023): Players Committee card image, 20 February 2023: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-allegiantgeneralpryde-20230220.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8c98fe0/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/allegiantgeneralpryde.png Holotable commit 8c98fe0 “Set 12 Remastered”], mark “E1”). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Hux is forfeit -3. While with a Resistance character, adds one battle destiny. While Emperor on table, attrition against opponent here is +1 for each First Order character here (limit +3).” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 12 remaster: the card was re-rendered (745×1039, was 703×980); new art-credit wording (“Image courtesy of Wattos Scrapyard @ Facebook”) and copyright line (“ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”); same words; the mark is now “E1”. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
*: [[File:V12-D-allegiantgeneralpryde-20230220-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Allegiant General Pryde (Errata 3)]], 12 December 2025): Players Committee card image, 12 December 2025: 0 side [[:File:V12-D-allegiantgeneralpryde.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ffcb1fc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual12-Dark/hires/allegiantgeneralpryde.png Holotable commit ffcb1fc “First Order Icon”], mark “E1”). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Hux is forfeit -3. While with a Resistance character, adds one battle destiny. While Emperor on table, attrition against opponent here is +1 for each First Order character here (limit +3).” '''What changed:''' the First Order icon in the top-left corner was redrawn; nothing else changed. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version). '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 3 by release order (PC-E3); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
